entries.sentence: A component crashed on an unexpected condition; the request or task it was handling failed.
entries.action: Report the support reference to the platform team; the log line holds the bounded stack.

entries.sentence: An unexpected error stopped this request.
entries.action: Try again; if it repeats, report the support reference to the platform team.

entries.sentence: The toolkit's settings could not be resolved, so the request could not run.
entries.action: Check the toolkit's credentials and configuration, then reload the page.

entries.sentence: Main lost its database; requests that need it fail and Workers get retryable answers until it is back.
entries.action: Check PostgreSQL and PgBouncer; Main resumes on its own when the database answers again.

entries.sentence: Main lost NATS; admitted runs wait in the outbox and claimed runs continue.
entries.action: Check the NATS server; Main reconnects on its own.

entries.sentence: A runtime server cannot read workload sessions, so Workers are answered retry until the database is back.
entries.action: Check PostgreSQL; Workers retry within their lease.

entries.sentence: A background runner failed its pass and will try again.
entries.action: Read the cause; while a dependency outage is already reported, these lines are at DEBUG.

entries.sentence: A background runner stopped on a dependency failure and is being restarted.
entries.action: Nothing, unless it repeats after the dependency is back; then read the cause.

entries.sentence: A background runner stopped for a reason that does not heal on its own, so Main is exiting.
entries.action: Read the cause and fix it; compose or Kubernetes restarts Main.
